delivered.statement: Achieved highest ever quarterly revenue of Rs.98,000 Crores, up 11% YoY
Added 36.3 million subscribers YoY to 524 million; 5G base grew 77 million to 268 million
We crossed Rs.30,000 Crores in PAT; EBITDA Rs.76,255 Crores with 52% margin
Closed revenue of Rs.22,000 Crores in 2026, two times growth on similar period last year
Monthly active user reach of 550 million; broke world record 72.5 million concurrent streams
Crossed milestone of 20,000 stores; opened 1000 big box hypermarket supermarkets
30% growth in average daily orders QoQ, 300% YoY; serving 1200 plus cities
Total data traffic increased to 241 Exabytes for year, 31% increase year-on-year

themes: Strait of Hormuz blockade disrupts Middle East crude, naphtha, LNG supplies; freight/insurance costs spike 10-15x
Consumer businesses lead: Jio +18%, retail +8%, FMCG +100% YoY; 55% of group EBITDA now
Quick commerce scales rapidly with margin pressure; omnichannel focus on customer wallet share, not dark store count
New Energy projects advance: green ammonia supply contract signed, giga factory commissioning progressing on schedule
Jio momentum sustained: 54% on 5G, 4% organic ARPU growth without tariff hikes, 268M 5G users
Operational headwinds: Rupee depreciation 11% YoY, SAED reintroduction, Qatar LNG force majeure limits gas supply
risks: Middle East infrastructure damage (3M bpd refining offline, 10M bpd crude cut); uncertain recovery timeline creates sustained supply risk
SAED reintroduction on diesel, gasoline limits domestic fuel marketing profitability; ongoing Rupee depreciation pressure
Qatar LNG force majeure on 77M tons capacity declared; 5-year recovery expected; 60% of Indian LNG from Qatar affected
Red Sea navigation fears persistent despite Houthi pause; insurance and freight remain at elevated levels, margin compression risk

analyst_pushback.question: Do alternate crude sources (US, Africa, Venezuela) adversely impact distillate yield?
analyst_pushback.response: Venezuelan crude positive; Russian Urals lookalike to Middle East; blending flexibility manages composition risks well

analyst_pushback.question: Will RIL increase fuel retail prices amid margin losses?
analyst_pushback.response: Will not curtail operations; viewing situation long-term; PSUs absorb bulk of burden; fossil fuels demand continues longer

analyst_pushback.question: Quick commerce consolidation strategy; specific dark store or market share targets?
analyst_pushback.response: No specific targets; focus on wallet share; dark stores fill gaps where concentration exists; omnichannel network approach

analyst_pushback.question: What are Jio's financial targets (ROIC, FCF) for next one-two years?
analyst_pushback.response: Not providing forward looking guidance; priorities market share, homes growth, digital services scaling

tone_evidence: Management delighted with performance quality; navigating severe disruptions via agile sourcing and operational excellence
